rules._comment: Hateful Strike soak: glue all tanks to the boss in melee so the two highest-HP bodies are the only eligible strike targets (never a squishy). No phases/adds/AoE; Frenzy + Berserk are unreactable wipe-timers. See BossNotes/Patchwerk.md.

Everyone else focuses the boss; ranged DPS stay at cast range, naturally outside the 5y Hateful Strike radius. Healers run their own heal strategy untouched. (C++ 'rear flank' + ranged-hold intentionally dropped: no Level-2 distance-hold, and 'rear flank' would pull casters into the 5y zone.)
